architecture_notes: Engine is generic; junk knowledge lives in versioned declarative YAML packs (id, category, risk, platform, paths, globs, min_age_days, max_depth, delete_mode, default_enabled, report_only), not hardcoded heuristics (BleachBit lesson).
Plan-then-execute: scan is a true dry-run of clean; same category/age filters; optional JSON plan export/import; never silent mass delete.
Risk is binding product policy: only risk=low may default_enabled and mutate; medium|high map to report_only behavior for mutation even if a pack file mis-sets flags.
Trash-first backends via trash crate (FreeDesktop/macOS/Windows); permanent is a second hard gate with typed DELETE phrase.
Contents-only delete_mode preferred so rule roots (Caches, Logs, Temp) are not removed.
Browser cache rules separate from cookies/logins/history; privacy high-risk stays off and never mixed into cache labels.
Dev reclaim prioritizes global download caches (npm/yarn/pip/Homebrew); project node_modules/target walks stay opt-in/report-only with markers and age.
Report-only for system landmines: Prefetch, Windows.old/WinSxS, Xcode Archives, Docker disks, pnpm store, old kernels, journal paths.
Never-touch and report_only cannot be overridden by user allowlists or rule YAML.
stdout holds table/JSON only; stderr holds progress/warnings so CI pipes stay clean; non-TTY never prompt-hangs.
Exit codes are API: 0 empty-or-full success, 1 partial/operational failure, 2 usage/config.
Honest sizing: measured reclaimable matched-file bytes only; no double-count, free-space-as-junk, or dirty-score meters.
macOS path priority: ~/Library/Caches+Logs, $TMPDIR, Homebrew, Quick Look; Xcode medium off; Mail/iOS backups report-only.
Linux: XDG cache/thumbnails/user temp/logs; package caches privileged/off; Flatpak/snap leftovers report-only.
Windows: user TEMP and thumbnail caches default; system TEMP/Prefetch/browser privacy opt-in or report-only.
Unbounded home/disk walks forbidden; every rule has explicit roots, max_depth, and optional min_age.
Native-tool preference layer records recommended commands for report-only hits without shelling out from rule YAML.
Post-MVP plugins (docker prune, leftovers, journal vacuum) must emit the same Candidate model and default to report-only.
MVP is path-based only; no code execution in rules.
cli_commands: ppduster scan [-c CATEGORY...] [--all] [--min-age N] [--limit N] [-o table|json]
modules: rules: load/merge YAML packs (schema_version, pack_version), path-template expand, platform filter, risk defaults
scan: bounded walk of rule roots with age/glob/max_depth; size + rule-id attribution; open-file skip
safety: hard never-touch denylist, canonicalize, symlink stay-under-root, TOCTOU revalidate, refuse failed normalize
risk_gate: default_enabled only for risk=low; medium|high|report_only never mutate on normal clean even if pack flags mis-set
clean: dry-run default; trash crate backend; permanent only with --permanent + typed DELETE; deepest-first; skip locked
report: human table + stable JSON; category totals; deleted/skipped/errors; stdout data, stderr progress on TTY
plan: export/import apply plan sharing scan/clean filters so dry-run is a true preview
audit: local JSONL deletion log (method, rule id, size, skips/errors); no path telemetry off-box
doctor: packs loaded, platform, denylist sample, trash backend health
cli: clap subcommands, shared filters, exit codes 0/1/2 (success, partial/ops failure, usage/config)
native_hints (suggest): non-executing OS/PM guidance strings for report-only hits
mvp_scope: Ship a solid cross-platform CLI+library: load shipped packs (macos/linux/windows/dev/apps), scan and clean with identical filters, Trash-first deletes for default low-risk only after --yes, JSON/table reports, plan export/import, doctor/rules/categories/suggest, hard never-touch + risk_gate + safety tests, local deletion audit log. Default preset is low-risk user-space regenerable junk on the host platform (caches/logs/temp/thumbnails/package download caches/light leftovers/saved-state/known app caches). Medium+ and report_only categories (browser disk cache, Xcode DerivedData/DeviceSupport/Archives, Docker disks, node_modules/target, pnpm store, Prefetch, WinSxS/Windows.old, privacy artifacts, mail/iOS backups, system landmines) scan and report with native-tool hints but never delete on the normal clean path. Explicitly out of MVP: GUI/menu-bar, Smart Care upsell, registry cleaners, malware scanners, secure shred/free-space wipe, full AppCleaner leftover uninstall graph, duplicate/similar-media engines, Docker/volume/package/journal mutation backends, unbounded home walks, scheduled daemon, freemium/telemetry, history/restore UX, interactive TUI multi-select of medium risk. macOS is primary validation OS; Linux and Windows packs ship and work without elevation for user-scope targets. Plugins later (docker prune, journalctl, apt clean) must share Candidate model and default report-only.
safety_model: Fail-closed safety-maximalist model. (1) scan never mutates; clean without --yes is dry-run of the same Candidate pipeline/filters. (2) Default-enabled rules are risk=low only with min_age_days floors (typically 2-14d); optional global --min-age override. (3) Medium, high, and report_only are inventory-only on the normal clean path even with --yes; no MVP flag bulk-upgrades medium+ to delete. (4) OS Trash/Recycle is the only default mutation; --permanent requires typed confirm phrase DELETE, not --yes alone. (5) Hard never-touch denylist (Documents/Desktop/Downloads/Pictures, Mail/Messages/Keychains, .ssh/.gnupg, home roots, /System, /usr, WinSxS, Program Files) wins over rules and user allowlists. (6) Canonicalize paths; refuse failed normalize and symlink escapes past rule roots. (7) Prefer contents-only delete_mode so rule roots (Caches, Logs, Temp) are not removed. (8) Skip locked/in-use files; revalidate never-touch and existence at delete time. (9) Never-touch and report_only cannot be overridden by allowlists or rule YAML. (10) Honest measured reclaimable bytes only; full path+rule-id audit; partial cleans exit non-zero on failures. No root required for core MVP; no shred/wipe, registry, malware theater, telemetry, or scareware health scores.
stack: Rust 2021 single binary + library (clap, serde_yaml/json, walkdir, globset, trash, dirs, tabled/bytesize, chrono, anyhow/thiserror). Declarative YAML rule packs as data under rules/ (macos, linux, windows, dev, apps). No GUI runtime, no network in core; MIT; offline local-first.
summary: Local-first, open-source, rule-driven junk cleaner CLI (macOS first, then Linux, then Windows). Reclaims space from regenerable user caches, logs, temp files, package-manager download caches, thumbnails, saved application state, and selected app caches via versioned YAML rule packs. Core loop is scan (honest sizes, rule-id attribution) then clean dry-run then explicit --yes into OS Trash; medium+ and report_only stay inventory-only on the normal path. No scareware scores, telemetry, GUI, malware claims, registry cleaners, or silent bulk wipe.
